CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2580 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 3541137e8998aa0b2c609d4429feb37e5999140d. Bus nonce: 744dbd9b5d8b7ecc44e43aaae5d22d82. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 3541137e8998aa0b2c609d4429feb37e5999140d`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 3541137e8998aa0b2c609d4429feb37e5999140d` or `Fix review: blocked 3541137e8998aa0b2c609d4429feb37e5999140d <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 744dbd9b5d8b7ecc44e43aaae5d22d82`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `3541137e8998aa0b2c609d4429feb37e5999140d` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2580 3541137e8998aa0b2c609d4429feb37e5999140d") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2580-744dbd9b`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
DELTA RE-REVIEW of PR #2580 (R10-FLOW-RELAY-HOLD, branch fix/r10-flow-relay-hold) at head 3541137e8998aa0b2c609d4429feb37e5999140d. Last verdict was merge at 808137a949c2c1ce64acc340cfd72ccfebc7a6b8 (`git fetch origin review/2580 && git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md`, commit 8ba20edf5). Since then only merges of origin/main landed (conflict resolutions, fixer tip 0e4558f43) plus a body refresh. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1. Spare the GitHub API.
Check: 1. `git diff 808137a9 3541137e -- $(git diff --name-only $(git merge-base origin/main 3541137e) 3541137e)` minus main's own changes: every conflict resolution keeps both main's change and this PR's fix; the PR's own diff against its merge base is the same fix the merge verdict approved. 2. The fix's tests still pass at the head; re-apply the mutation-proof mutant(s) named in the body and confirm they fail. 3. Every figure in the body re-derives at this head; `## Red checks` names every red in the branch history (check-runs API, one read); merge-tree with origin/main clean; carry_audit check --body 0 unrouted 0 bad.
Return merge unless an item fails. Time box 30 min.
